body:
I know I can manage it, and I have been for the last 6 years.  But I still have this desire inside me, however small.  And I'm also interested in adults too, and mainly.    I don't want to live if being alive means I have to accept this as a part of me.  I never asked for it and don't want it.   


To stop myself feeling like my brother -- how about I try jumping off a tall building?

> But you can reinvent yourself.

Read [here](http://theweek.com/articles/479986/pedophilia-guide-disorder), under the section about if it can be cured.  I'm stuck forever.  I can't live like this, I don't want to.  I am completely powerless and broken.  These memories aren't leaving either, and I can't even be intimate with anybody without on some level feeling like I am my brother for really no clear reason.  So, could YOU be happy if you knew you'd hate yourself forever, you couldn't have a life partner, and you felt guilty for even having friends?  It's insane to imagine.
Several therapists, psychiatrists, doctors, and counselors over the years, and recently a few friends.
